sources.support: Section 19: Provincial/City Health Boards oversee and coordinate integration; supervision and fund responsibilities. Section 20: pooled Special Health Fund. Section 30: coordinated health promotion, literacy and preventive care. Province-wide systems include municipal/component-city systems; city-wide systems concern highly urbanised/independent component cities.
sources.limits: No claim that every locality has completed integration, every BHW sits on a board, or every community question must reach a board. No universal local routing, entitlement or service promise.
